verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents hosted, production-ready, branded login pages (Universal Login). It also offers a no-code visual editor for custom signup and login flows, and community users corroborate the hosted Universal Login page. End-user profile management UI is not evidenced: the closest items are progressive-profiling metadata capture and pre-built admin components for B2B customer admins. Missing for 10: documented prebuilt profile-management pages or components for end users, embeddable framework UI components, and hands-on evidence of customization depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages

citations.quote: Deliver production-ready, branded login experiences quickly with Universal Login.
Create custom signup and login flows with flexibility and control using a no-code visual editor.
Quickly tailor the UI and business logic of your identity flows using a no-code editor.
Build custom signup and login flows to prompt users for additional information and store it as metadata on the Auth0 user profile.
Auth0's implementation of Universal Login didn't require JavaScript, which I liked
